title: Eat the rainbow
subtitle: More colors = more micronutrients
content: Try adding 2 colors to your plate today: greens + orange/red (like spinach + carrot).

title: Hydration tip
subtitle: Small sips add up
content: Keep a bottle nearby and drink 250ml every hour for 4 hours—easy progress toward your goal.

title: Reduce food waste
subtitle: Plan, store, reuse
content: Plan meals before shopping, store leftovers safely, and reuse them within 24 hours.
